name: English

_purpose.week_file: the file name of the weekly report billcall writes into the company's folder; the person sees it in their file list, so it is a plain word in their language
_purpose.week_title: the first heading of that report, read by the person who pays
_purpose.week_this_machine: heading of the part counted from this computer's Claude Code logs at list price
_purpose.week_team: heading of the part read from the organisation's spend-report CSV
_purpose.week_otel: heading of the part read from an OpenTelemetry export; keep the metric name as it is
_purpose.week_idle: heading of the list of paid seats nobody used this week; factual, never blaming
_purpose.guard_head: the budget line at session start; {parts} is the day and month parts joined by commas
_purpose.guard_day: today's part of the budget line; keep {spent}, {budget}, {share}
_purpose.guard_spent: appended when the budget is spent; it also tells Claude to ask the person responsible
_purpose.guard_partial: appended when the log scan stopped at its time limit

week_this_machine: This computer (Claude Code logs, at list price)
guard_head: billcall: AI spend on this computer at list price - {parts}
guard_spent: . The budget is spent: tell the person, and ask the one responsible before going on.
guard_50: . Half of the budget is gone.
guard_partial: (counted from part of the logs: the scan stopped at its time limit)
